i.sense: character: The ninth letter of the English alphabet, called i and wr…
i.hook: From Latin i, meaning "scribal abbreviation of inter".

i.sense: pron: Alternative letter-case form of I.

firstUse.quote: Here follow ſome few lines in the original, which not underſtanding i have omitted. […] Laſtly that amidſt ſo many viciſſitudes of fortune, to which I have been expoſed, amongſt all the goods, i ſay,
firstUse.source: 1762, Benj[amin] Stillingfleet, Miscellaneous Tracts Relating to Natural History, Husbandry, and Physick. To Which Is Added the Calendar of Flora., 2nd edition,
